Attribute-level survivorship: for each (domain_key, match_group_id, attribute_key) the single contributing source record whose value wins is picked per bus_rules.survivorship_rules (most_common/most_complete/oldest/newest/pattern_match/shortest_value, tie-broken by source_modified_date then domain_source_systems.sort_order)
Per-attribute survivorship winners pivoted back into one row per golden record's attributes JSON (golden_id = 'GOLD-<DOMAIN>-00001')
Survivorship winners grouped by contributing source record into the list of gold attributes that source won -- a single golden record can draw its email from one source and its address from another

Edge confidence (tier 1's auto_merge_threshold for an exact match, or the cosine similarity score for a fuzzy match -- bus_rules.matching_thresholds) becomes the crosswalk's match_confidence_score; an isolated single-source record falls back to the no_match_baseline 'provisional' score
Borderline fuzzy-match pairs (similarity between the review and auto-merge thresholds) surfaced for a data steward to confirm or reject
A steward's confirm/reject decision on a borderline pair is recorded here (maker-checker workflow match_review_confirmation)
Audit log entry written alongside the decision, recording the steward's action and note
Every AI-suggested and steward-applied remediation action against this exception is logged here (ai_suggested / steward_resolve_submitted / steward_resolved / approval_rejected)
Once a steward's correction passes re-validation and a Data Owner approves it (maker-checker workflow stewardship_remediation), the corrected attributes are stored here
The approved correction is upserted directly into silver.records by the real-time reprocessing path (api/reprocessing.py), outside the next batch dbt run
A confirmed pair is honored as a forced-merge (a rejected pair as a permanent exclusion) on the next matching run (scripts/generate_matches.py)
